text: “What is it?” “It is written inside the Golden Cap,” replied the Queen of the Mice. “But if you are going to call the Winged Monkeys we must run away, for they are full of mischief and think it great fun to plague us.” “Won’t they hurt me?” asked the girl anxiously. They must obey the wearer of the Cap. Good-bye!” And she scampered out of sight, with all the mice hurrying after her. Dorothy looked inside the Golden Cap and saw some words written upon the lining.
